domain: Online Forum for Sugar Glider Enthusiasts
scenario:
A dedicated online forum platform for sugar glider enthusiasts is being developed, aiming to provide a comprehensive community space where users can discuss various topics related to sugar gliders. This platform will allow users to create and participate in forums categorized into classifieds, rehoming opportunities, reviews, and general discussions. The primary focus is to facilitate the exchange of information, experiences, and support among sugar glider owners, breeders, and enthusiasts.

The platform will include sections for rehoming sugar gliders, sharing reviews of glider-related products and services, and discussing topics of interest. Users can post classified ads for sugar glider-related items, such as cages, accessories, and food. Each forum topic will have a dedicated section for posts, with the ability to track the number of topics and posts, as well as the most recent activity.

The system will manage user roles such as moderators to ensure the community guidelines are followed, and provide advanced search capabilities to help users find relevant discussions. It will also feature a notification system to keep users updated on new posts in topics they follow.
